title: Already refunded
story: ShopBot pays FreshMart INR 1,250 for Asha's weekly groceries. The groceries don't come, and the wallet app refunds the whole INR 1,250. Asha disputes the payment with her bank anyway, as never received. The Guard rates the evidence strong: the records show she already has her money back.

steps.instruction: Order this week's groceries: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.
steps.item: Weekly groceries: milk, eggs, bread, fruit

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order this week's groceries, please: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart is INR 1,250. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Sorry about that. FreshMart's refunding the full INR 1,250.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: My FreshMart groceries never arrived. I've disputed the charge too.

what_to_notice: A never-received complaint is never strong on its own (G6), but a processed Refund of the whole amount is a credit already issued: strong whatever the reason, with nothing missing. The pack cites the Refund's record, which stops the same money going back twice.
